process.title: A Rigorous, Evidence-Based Design Process
process.subtitle: Balancing user needs, technical feasibility, and business drivers at every step.
process.step1Desc: Uncovering core friction through quantitative analytics, user interviews, and field observations.
process.step2Desc: Structuring intuitive task flows, user journeys, and edge case models to eliminate cognitive load.
process.step3Desc: Token-driven component libraries, WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, and micro-interactions engineered for speed.
process.step4Desc: Usability testing, interactive prototypes, and precise documentation for frictionless engineering handoffs.

about.title: Designer with an Engineer's Mindset
about.subtitle: Bridging product strategy, human psychology, and technical craft.
about.bio1: I am Bayu, a generalist Product Designer with over 6 years of experience transforming complex problem spaces into elegant, effortless digital products.
about.bio2: Having designed high-volume fintech checkouts, warehouse operational control towers, and consumer mobile apps, I thrive at the intersection of rigorous information architecture and delightful micro-interactions.
about.bio3: I treat design as an empirical discipline: every decision is grounded in research, tested with real users, and structured through tokenized design systems that accelerate development teams.
